sourceInspection.aip8Boundary: AIP-8 owns a generic query/plan/saved-exploration shell; ecommerce Insight/GrowthPlan/EffectReview semantics stay in the SolutionPack/Workshop L1 domain.

frozenAuthorityDecision.insight: InsightRevision is append-only and typed as observation, correlation, attribution or causal claim, with exact metric/evidence/method/eval refs and uncertainty.
frozenAuthorityDecision.decisionSummary: DecisionSummary stores conclusion, evidence chain, attribution path, key assumptions, counter-evidence, alternatives and uncertainty; it never stores or exposes private model chain-of-thought.
frozenAuthorityDecision.growthPlan: GrowthPlanRevision is append-only with objective, constraints, budget, expected effects, confidence, stop conditions and exact refs; revise uses expectedVersion.
frozenAuthorityDecision.materialization: TaskGraph materialization is an explicit idempotent command over one approved exact GrowthPlanRevision and atomically preserves eligible plan-item to canonical Task count and mapping.
frozenAuthorityDecision.effectReview: EffectReview is append-only and binds baseline, comparison, maturity window, eligible population, method, assumptions, limitations, receipts and exact plan/task refs.
frozenAuthorityDecision.correction: Late data, method drift, assumption correction or plan replacement creates a successor revision and invalidates affected readiness without overwriting historical decisions or effects.

requiredInvariants: Observation/correlation/attribution/causal types never silently upgrade one another.
Every conclusion and plan item has exact metric/evidence/method/eval refs at one frozen cutoff.
Materialization is all-or-nothing and eligiblePlanItemCount equals createdOrExistingCanonicalTaskCount with a one-to-one mapping ledger.
Repeated materialization key with the same hash returns the same graph; a different hash conflicts.
Metric/evidence/eval drift after approval blocks materialization until an explicit successor decision.
EffectReview remains pending before maturity and unknown/inconclusive is not counted as success or zero effect.
Assumption correction and late data append successors while prior DecisionSummary, Plan, TaskGraph and EffectReview remain reachable.
MemoryCandidate creation is a separate governed proposal and never automatic promotion from EffectReview.
